proposed_actions: Review the detailed task_card, model_config, and relevant case_adapter facts with their available provenance; produce the model intake audit and an explicit assumptions-and-gaps record.

Run the registered task and model checks and SACG static check on the actual artifacts. Handoff only checker-grounded facts and unresolved gaps to the cross-layer readiness auditor and SACG extraction.
risks: SACG extraction could encode unsupported model semantics if it treats the compact summaries or artifact names as evidence for decoder type, dimensions, attention behavior, head mapping, sequence limits, or operator ordering.

A checker failure or a source-level ambiguity should be recorded as a bounded gap and routed for evidence or owner clarification; do not resolve it by changing or selecting target-model semantics.
